svg.title: GainSec — mission dossier
svg.desc: Mission dossier for GainSec (GainSec): 8 featured projects. Shown: the first project's card fully written (now loading: gainsec; operation:), its 2x4 technology screen with the device at its first frame, and the mission log of every project with the first framed (the animated file plays them all in turn). 1. AutoProber (gainsec/autoprober) — operation a.u.t.o.p.r.o.b.e.r. — "agent under tight oversight probes really obscure boards entirely robotically"; mission 036; ★ 336 · ⑂ 20 · python · 1 issue; vs. nap enforcement; 2x4 technology: a bench CNC gantry with a stepper motor, a microscope and a probe needle over a circuit board on the plate; lumber: 304 ft (7285 KB). 2. Treehouse Defense System (gainsec/tree-house-defense-system-tds) — operation t.d.s. — "treehouse defense system"; mission 051; ★ 5 · ⑂ 0 · typescript; pushed within 30 days; 2x4 technology: a tree with a deck, a shack, a school bus leaning in the branches, two dishes, an antenna, two monitors, a ladder and a tyre swing; lumber: 2871 ft (68896 KB). 3. BattleReadyArmor — Slim (gainsec/battlereadyarmor-slim) — operation b.r.a. — "battle ready armor"; mission 040; ★ 6 · ⑂ 0 · html; has releases; 2x4 technology: a kid in armour: a spiked bowl helmet with a wide neck guard, shoulder plates, a chest plate numbered 137, gauntlets, a plated skirt and big boots; lumber: 7296 ft (175098 KB). 4. AgentReadyArmor — Teaser (gainsec/agentreadyarmor-teaser) — operation a.r.a. — "agent ready armor"; mission 041; ★ 0 · ⑂ 0 · html; 2x4 technology: the same armour worn by a robot: a box head with a visor and an antenna, and a sealed badge on the chest plate; lumber: 3 ft (60 KB). 5. ArcticBase (gainsec/arcticbase) — operation a.r.c.t.i.c.-b.a.s.e. — "agents request clearance then idle chilling before anything starts executing"; mission 039; ★ 16 · ⑂ 0 · python; pushed within 30 days; 2x4 technology: an ice crystal holding a snowflake built of planks, with ski goggles across it; lumber: 136 ft (3254 KB). 6. BirdShot (gainsec/birdshot) — operation b.i.r.d.s.h.o.t. — "bird-hunters inspect real devices sanctioned hacking offline testing"; mission 046; ★ 42 · ⑂ 3 · python; 2x4 technology: a roadside pole with a solar panel, a camera on an arm and a junction box, and a bird perched on the panel; lumber: 162 ft (3898 KB). 7. DWARF (pragma-org/dwarf) — operation d.w.a.r.f. — "delivers weird abuse records fallout"; external mission (not one of this profile's repositories: no tokens or callouts); 2x4 technology: a round three-neck flask with corks, an eye and a grin inside, on a tripod ring with a serpent knot. 8. Super Awesome AI Driver (gainsec/super-awesome-ai-driver) — operation s.a.a.d. — "super awesome ai driver"; mission 048; ★ 2 · ⑂ 1 · python · 1 issue; vs. early curfew squad; 2x4 technology: a go-kart on four fat wheels with a camera on a spring, a microphone on a gooseneck, a seat, a steering wheel and a canister; lumber: 225 ft (5392 KB). Devices are green wireframes with every edge drawn, modelled on each project's own hardware or logo; their callouts read lumber = size ÷ 24 KB in feet, speed = stars in mph, tape = open issues in rolls, crew = forks in kids. End transmission — transmission 2026-10-22, sector g.
